description: #749 one-hop def/use regressions: an untrusted-source assignment one line above a path construction must fire even when the construction is a trusted-anchor call (path.resolve(__dirname, name), os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), name), a pathlib chain joinpath) — the anchor neutralization must be refused so the construction survives to be scanned. The plain non-anchor one-hop join keeps firing under the tightened def/use rule.
diff:
diff --git a/src/app/flow.py b/src/app/flow.py
+++ b/src/app/flow.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
+name = request.args["path"]
+target = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), name)
diff --git a/src/app/flow.ts b/src/app/flow.ts
+++ b/src/app/flow.ts
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
+const requested = req.query.path;
+const resolved = path.resolve(__dirname, requested);
